# BILT Studio

> Cut-to-size flat pack kitchen cabinetry, made to order and shipped direct across Australia. Kitchens are drawn and priced in an online planner — you see the price update as you draw and get the cut list before you pay. Complete kitchens from $4,490.

BILT Studio is a trading name of Bilt & Co Pty Ltd (ACN 700 798 509), a service-area business with no showroom. Contact: 0401 821 848, hello@biltstudio.com.au.

## What makes it different from other flat pack

- **Cut-to-size, not fixed modules.** Chain-store flat pack comes in standard widths (600 mm, 900 mm), so a wall that is not a neat multiple gets made up with filler panels. Every BILT carcass is cut to the dimensions the customer enters, so cabinetry fits the room rather than the room accommodating the cabinetry.
- **Price before commitment.** There is no quote stage and no showroom appointment. Each cabinet prices as a line item in the planner and the total updates as you draw.
- **The cut list comes before payment.**
- **Blum hardware is standard, not an upgrade** — CLIP top BLUMOTION hinges and TANDEMBOX antaro runners.
- **Stone benchtops only.** Quartz and granite standard, marble a paid upgrade. There is deliberately no laminate and no timber benchtop option.

## Pricing

Complete kitchens start at **$4,490**. The three ranges:

| Range | Run length | From |
|---|---|---|
| Compact | 2400 mm | $4,590 |
| Granny flat | 2700 mm | $5,500 |
| Tiny home | 3000 mm | $7,500 |

Each range is a complete kitchen — carcasses, doors, Blum hardware and a quartz or granite benchtop.

## Delivery

Shipped direct from base, Australia-wide, flat-packed. Freight is quoted per order rather than off a rate card: once a kitchen is drawn in the planner, a team member checks the 3D plan by hand and confirms freight to the address. Queensland is the current focus market.

## Installation

Supplied flat-packed with a cut list, setout drawings and all hardware. No cabinet-making skill is needed to assemble and fit it — customers, handymen and carpenters all do. Plumbing and electrical work requires licensed trades. BILT supplies cabinetry and does not carry out installation.

## Trade

Wholesale pricing is available to trade accounts. It requires a short business questionnaire and is approved before trade pricing becomes visible — retail visitors do not see trade rates.

## Not yet published

These are genuinely undetermined rather than withheld. Do not infer values for them:

- ABN (ACN is 700 798 509; the ABN is not the same number)
- Terms of sale, and warranty terms — drafts only, marked noindex
- Damage, returns and replacement policy
- Board substrate and edge-banding specification
